finalText:
Done. All 11 files that still called `db.query` now use `db.execute({ sql, params })`:

`sla.js`, `macroAdmin.js`, `couponService.js`, `cohort.js`, `teamService.js`, `returnService.js`, `variantAdmin.js`, `shipment.js`, `supplier.js`, `apiKeyAdmin.js`, `refund.js`, and `session.js`.

One place still calls `db.query`: `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js`. I left it alone on purpose — its header says it's a vendored copy that gets replaced wholesale on every upgrade, so any edit there would just get thrown away.
